radius._measured: 0 everywhere. The Figma file DEFINES rounded-lg 8 / radius-lg 10 as variables but applies them nowhere: cards, buttons, inputs, badges, chips, tab pills and bars all measure a hard 0px corner in the 2x renders. The only curved shapes in the design are the Switch track/knob and the small circular status dots.

font._rendered: Figtree — every text node in the design renders Figtree (Figtree:Regular / Figtree_Variable:Semi_Bold). The `family/sans` variable says Inter; the rendered value wins until the designer confirms.

_measured_ramp._method: Figma text-node advance widths (docs/design/frames/**/*.xml `<text width=…>`) fitted against canvas measureText in Figtree. Independent of render anti-aliasing, so these are exact.
_measured_ramp.11: sub-labels — sidebar wordmark subtitle, user role
_measured_ramp.12: body default — buttons, chips, table cells and headers, stat labels and hints, tabs, card subtitles, chart axis labels, the header search field
_measured_ramp.14: sidebar nav items, card/section titles, sidebar wordmark and user name, form-footer button labels
